accounting.implicit_stop_evaluations: all evaluated prefixes; known zero incremental reward

retained_prefix_diagnostics.distance_semantics: maximum recorded entry-to-tip insertion distance; not cumulative path length
retained_prefix_diagnostics.terminal_selection: best at most beam_width by the existing return/path ordering
retained_prefix_diagnostics.wall_accounting: diagnostic bookkeeping included in existing wall budget

observed_beam.interpretation: Saved capped search proposal only; partial actions including any STOP are not an accepted/executed plan
observed_beam.reason: Observed search exceeded its declared episode time

cost_scope: Selector-only time excludes construction, collection and replay. Each planning_and_replay phase includes selection plus native/independent replay; inventory/transition/forward timers are nested and must not be added.
information_scope: same permitted arrays, physical task, initial inventory and public-target context; actor features and planner computation differ, so no identical-representation claim
limits: Saved receipts and reviewed source; no independent syscall trace, tensor reload, array reread or geometric recomputation. Explicit post-exposure S-union-T world, preserved full target and declared workspace; no clinical/material validation, success threshold or equal-cost claim. Source-zero is not proven air, outside-image extent and between-insertion transfers remain unassessed.

observed_beam.scope: capped selector only; no accepted collection/native replay

observed_greedy.scope: selection only; construction, trace collection and independent replay charged separately

post_exposure.seed_rule: Ds&~O; proximal distal_face_on_plane; entire footprint strictly_inside_disc

source_domains.external_tool_extent: declared E and outside-image extent unassessed; observed Ds unchanged
source_domains.simulated_zero_meaning: explicit occupancy-model assumption only within interaction domain
source_domains.source_label_zero_meaning: known annotation zero, not physically empty anatomy
source_domains.unknown_interaction_rule: U except declared wholly-proximal E blocks full tool; no U seed, flood or removal
